name: The Keith household at 1906 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_keith_mrs_edson

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1906 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1906 Mrs. Edson Keith.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1906, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The three live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census (T624 roll 241, ED 166 and 167) was read for this card's children: the children it lists, and those the Blue Book lists at the number from 1890 to 1911, are on the card with the years each lived here, whether or not they were at home in 1904. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. Edson Keith
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Edson Keith here as head, born July 1839, in Illinois, widowed (ED 40, sheet 4B, line 95, leaf n801).

born.note: The existing census transcription gives born July 1839. The year is carried into the age shown on this card.

portrait_research.note: An individual portrait has not yet been verified in the period portrait books and Glessner House Museum article archive searched for this project. Any figure shown is a reconstruction, not an attested likeness.

persons.name: Edson Keith jr.
persons.note: Listed at 1906 under Mr. and Mrs. Edson Keith in 1890 and 1891, and with his wife in 1892; the 'jr.' names him the son of the house. From the 1894 edition he lives at 2110, where he and his family are on their own card in 1904. The 1910 census has his mother the mother of two children, both living (ED 166, sheet 8B, line 71, leaf n1444).

persons.name: Walter W. Keith
persons.note: Listed at 1906 under his parents from 1890, and with his own wife in 1897. In 1910 the census finds Walter W. Keith, 40, next door at 1904 with his wife Frances and son Winchester (ED 166, sheet 8B, lines 76-78), and the widow at 1906 the mother of two living children; with Edson Keith jr. that makes the two. That he was her son is read from the listing and that count.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (ladies maid); born November 1865, in Sweden, came to the United States in 1889, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904.
